name: NERDiQ LABS
summary:
NERDiQ LABS gives students access to a state-of-the-art laboratory or workshop. It also makes it possible to make concrete learning situations by offering an immersive, interactive, and realistic environment. NERDiQ LABS can be accessed from anywhere, making it perfect for online teaching or isolated students. The multi-person option makes teacher coaching possible and easy.
